content: I prostrate to the venerable gurus.The essential meaning of all the Victor's scriptures,The path praised by the holy Sons of the Victors,The gateway for the fortunate who desire liberation—I shall explain these as well as I am able.You who are not attached to the pleasures of existence,Who strive to make this life of leisure and opportunity meaningful,And who trust in the path that delights the Victors—You fortunate ones, listen with a clear mind.Without pure renunciation, there is no way to pacifyThe pursuit of pleasurable results in the ocean of existence;And since craving for existence thoroughly binds all embodied beings,Seek renunciation first.By habituating the mind to the difficulty of finding leisure and opportunityAnd the lack of time in this life, the preoccupation with this life is reversed.By repeatedly contemplating the unfailing laws of karma and the sufferings of cyclic existence,The preoccupation with future lives is reversed.By familiarizing yourself in this way, not even a momentary wishFor the excellences of cyclic existence will arise,And when a mind seeking liberation day and nightHas emerged, at that time renunciation has been born.Furthermore, if that renunciation is not embraced by a pure aspiration for awakening,It will not become a cause for the perfect bliss of unsurpassed enlightenment,Because it lacks that support;Therefore, the wise should generate the supreme bodhicitta.Swept away by the current of the four powerful rivers,Bound by the tight shackles of karma so difficult to undo,Trapped within the iron mesh of self-grasping,And completely enveloped by the dense darkness of ignorance,Born and reborn in limitless cyclic existence,They are continuously tormented by the three sufferings.Thinking of the plight of all these mothers who have fallen into such a state,Generate the supreme mind of enlightenment.If you lack the wisdom realizing the way things are,Even if you cultivate renunciation and the awakening mind,You will be unable to cut the root of cyclic existence;Therefore, strive in the means for realizing dependent origination.Whoever sees that the causality of all phenomena of saṃsāra and nirvāṇaIs never-failing, and for whom all focal points of objectification have collapsed,That person has truly entered the path that pleases the Buddhas.(This line is intentionally left blank to maintain the 4-line structure of the source text.)As long as the two understandings—of appearance as infallible dependent origination,And of emptiness as being free of all assertions—appear to be separate,As long as they appear as distinct,One has not yet realized the intent of the Sage.When, simultaneously and without alternation,The mere sight of infallible dependent originationCauses all modes of grasping at objects of certainty to dissolve,Then the analysis of the view is complete.Furthermore, appearance dispels the extreme of existence,And emptiness dispels the extreme of non-existence;If one knows how emptiness itself arises as cause and effect,One will not be captivated by views that grasp at extremes.When you have realized, just as they are, the essential pointsOf the three principal aspects of the path,Rely on solitude and generate the power of diligence,And swiftly accomplish your ultimate goal, my son.This was given as instruction by the widely learned bhikṣu Losang Drakpa Pel to the Tsa-kho Ponpo Ngawang Drakpa.
